root_cause: A multiline string replacement used to patch a shell continuation in powerhouse-obligation-terminalizer.yml corrupted the run block: the Candidate-Type condition was truncated and a duplicate tail of the workflow was appended. GitHub therefore registered a zero-job failed workflow on main.
prevention: For workflow hotfiles, reconstruct from the last valid Git blob and apply line-local edits instead of multiline string replacement across shell continuations.
Require structural regression assertions that critical terminalizer steps occur exactly once.
Treat any zero-job workflow run after a workflow-file merge as a compile failure and block terminal closure.
Keep canonical Supabase migration-history routing changes bounded to classifier and path-allowlist lines.

evaluation.expected: The terminalizer YAML remains syntactically intact, contains one copy of each critical step, and recognizes canonical Supabase migration-history recovery without weakening unknown-runtime fail-closed behavior.
